960	What is the depth of this matter? These outcast souls are the souls of

961	the dust on the soles of the feet, the heels of the Mashiach's footsteps,

962	the souls of our generation, whom Yaakov Avinu had already

963	begun to work on correcting, to raise us up

964	to the Throne of Glory. And this cannot be done all at

965	once; it takes all the generations, the work of all

966	the tzaddikim, for every tzaddik helps and assists our

967	souls on this point. But the moment he

968	took the small jars, he in effect took the

969	souls of our generation.

970	These outcast souls are called the sparks of

971	the soles of the feet, the souls of the heels of

972	Mashiach. He had already begun working on our correction, in effect,

973	by taking this aspect. It is known that there is

974	a part of the commentators, some commentators, who bring

975	this foundation, this point: that these two

976	small jars went with

977	Israel.

978	These jars went with Israel. It is brought

979	that these jars, whose oil reached Yaakov Avinu, reached

980	Moshe Rabbenu. With this oil he anointed the Mishkan and

981	the vessels of the Mishkan. After that it reached Shemuel the prophet,

982	with it he anointed Shaul and afterwards David HaMelech.

983	And this is brought in many other books, but

984	it is brought in several books, one of them

985	called Perush HaShelah on the Torah. He brings it in the name of

986	several commentators, saying that this oil was also

987	the oil that reached the Hashmonaim, the jar of oil

988	that was hidden beneath the altar. When was the

989	jar of oil that Matityahu

990	and his sons found hidden? It was written in the Megillat

991	Hashmonaim that it was from the time of Shemuel the prophet, the jar of

992	oil. Why, apparently, from the time of Shemuel the prophet

993	and David HaMelech? Because David HaMelech found

994	the place of the altar, the place of the Beit HaMikdash,

995	and he marked it and began to cut, to prepare

996	the place for establishing the altar. At that time they hid it.

997	With ruach hakodesh they knew, with ruach hakodesh they knew that it would be

998	needed. They hid it in a crevice, meaning in a pit

999	in the walls of the Shittim channel beneath the altar. Afterwards

1000	they rebuilt the altar. Until the altar was destroyed,

1001	they did not find this jar of oil. That is, until

1002	the Greeks destroyed it, they

1003	could not find it, because the time to find it

1004	had not yet come. So this jar of oil

1005	that the Hashmonaim found is the jar of oil drawn from

1006	Yaakov Avinu, which made the miracle.

1007	>> The oil that made the miracle?

1008	>> Yes, the oil through which the miracle of the Menorah was done,

1009	it is from the jar of oil of Yaakov Avinu, yes.

1010	Yaakov.

1011	>> Is this rabbi connected...

1012	>> Wait, no.

1013	Ask at the end, because this...

1014	Ah.

1015	So in effect this oil, this oil is called, with HaShem's help,

1016	we will speak a little about this point, we will expand on it.

1017	It is called the light that the Menorah shone, that the Menorah

1018	shone in the miracle that happened with the Hashmonaim, it was drawn from the side of

1019	the Hidden Light, from the side of the Hidden Light. Therefore it is written in many

1020	books that since we fulfill the mitzvah of

1021	Chanucah corresponding to the miracle that happened in the time of the Hashmonaim,

1022	therefore also in the Chanucah candles the Hidden

1023	Light continues to shine.

1024	Next week, perhaps, we will speak about the fact that the Hidden

1025	Light is above all the limits of the Torah and above all the limits of

1026	the conduct of the world, this aspect, and it draws down

1027	all the correction and all the redemption of the Hidden

1028	Light. For one of the properties of the Hidden Light, there are

1029	many, I am saying one of the properties, is

1030	that in a place where the Hidden Light is revealed, no darkness is hidden

1031	from it. What does this mean? It nullifies all concealment, all impurity

1032	and every klipah. It makes it disappear. That is, impurity

1033	can exist only until the Hidden Light, the moment

1034	the Hidden Light is revealed, because all impurity exists because

1035	it entices us and it creates a concealment

1036	of the soul's connection with the Holy One, blessed be He. This is called

1037	the union of the soul with the Holy One, blessed be He, and there are levels.

1038	So impurity

1039	can exist and do its work at a time

1040	when there is no complete union of the soul with the Holy

1041	One, blessed be He, because all the temptations and all the concealments and all

1042	of this exist while the soul is not yet completely connected

1043	with the Holy One, blessed be He. The moment there is complete union

1044	of the soul with the Holy One, blessed be He, impurity does not

1045	exist at all, because its whole existence is from concealment. The moment

1046	there is no concealment, the Hidden Light nullifies the concealment,

1047	because it is revealed in the Jewish soul

1048	as a complete union, called complete union, and then

1049	it nullifies all the forces of impurity.

1050	The novelty here, let us say it in general terms and speak about it later,

1051	the novelty here is that all this is drawn from the oil, from the jar of oil

1052	that the Hashmonaim found, and this jar of oil passed through all

1053	the generations, anointed the Mishkan, anointed kings, Shaul

1054	and David, then more kings, and its source is in fact

1055	in the jars of oil of Yaakov Avinu, according to what Rabbenu the Ari

1056	HaKadosh says, that this oil in fact corresponds to the sparks

1057	of the souls, the souls of the final

1058	generation. What is the connection between these things?

1059	That the souls of the final generations are

1060	from the side of the Hidden Light. So in effect all the drawing down of

1061	the Hidden Light is from the side of the heels of Mashiach. Precisely

1062	the souls that are hardest to correct and most outcast

1063	are the ones who mainly draw down the secret of the Hidden Light

1064	that is revealed in the Chanucah candles. With HaShem's help we will expand

1065	on this. …
